Travelife ERP User Guide: Complete Manual

Welcome to this official guide. This help center is designed to support travel professionals through a practical guide to optimizing operational workflows, a digitalization initiative that is part of the sector modernization efforts promoted by the Ministry of Tourism and Maroc PME.

Key facts Travelife ERP user guide

  • Contents: the Travelife ERP user guide documents 8 modules: dashboard, bookings, CRM, sales, accounting / cash, booking files, planning and support.
  • Bookings: the Travelife booking engine handles both direct contracts (internal inventory) and global inventories via XML/API, from hotel bed banks to GDS air ticketing.
  • Finance: Travelife's Accounting / Cash module covers customer and supplier invoicing, cash registers, bank reconciliation, VAT control (DGI compliance) and credit reports.
  • Groups: Travelife's Booking Files module tracks load factor, gross margin and markup rate for group travel (GIT), tours and MICE events.
  • Support: Travelife trains teams as soon as the license is activated, sets up a dedicated WhatsApp group and responds via support@travelife.ma, with remote assistance when needed.

Key performance indicators (KPIs)

Advanced financial reporting

Revenue Y vs Y-1

Analyze growth with this guide and precise revenue metrics. The system automatically segments revenue by sales channel for a year-over-year comparison (Y vs Y-1).

  • Overall sales revenue: annual, monthly and daily granularity.
  • Strategic segmentation: B2B (corporate accounts) vs B2C (individual travelers).
  • Billing tracking: comparison between invoiced revenue and collected revenue.

Business workflow monitoring

Productivity

This guide helps you stay in control of productivity. The dashboard centralizes critical tasks so no lead slips through the cracks.

  • Pipeline management: number of proposals awaiting conversion.
  • Performance analysis: Top 5 Agents (productivity) and Top 5 Customers (business volume).
  • Operational alerts: urgent tasks and booking file deadlines.

Cash management

Cash flow and collections

Outstanding receivables & payments

Secure your company's financial future with rigorous tracking of cash flows. Travelife instantly identifies payment discrepancies and default risks.

  • Tracking of customer outstanding receivables and supplier payables.
  • Dynamic validation of incoming payments.
  • Revenue forecast charts based on confirmed booking files.

Product mix analysis

Margin by department

Identify the products that contribute most to your margin. The system breaks down profits by department: air ticketing, accommodation, travel packages, visas and transport services.

  • View by sales department.
  • Identification of the most profitable products.
02Own product

Bookings & inventory

Access: Main Menu › Bookings

The Travelife booking engine is a hybrid infrastructure that lets you manage your direct contracts (internal inventory) and global inventories via XML/API connectivity at the same time. This architecture ensures complete flexibility in travel production, from hotels to GDS air ticketing.

Accommodation & flights

Accommodation management

Bookings > Hotel

Combine the exclusivity of your negotiated rates with the power of global aggregators. Travelife synchronizes availability and rates for a competitive offer.

  • Internal hotel: entry of direct contracts, allotments, stop sales and seasonal rates.
  • API hotel: native access to global bed banks with instant confirmation.

Air ticketing

Bookings > Flights (API)

Direct integration with airline reservation servers for seamless PNR management. Benefit from real-time pricing and automated ticketing workflows.

  • Multi-destination search and filtering by airline.
  • Issuance and tracking of tickets issued via API.

Travel production & services

Destination logistics

Bookings > Activities / Transfers

Manage your transport services and tourist activities. Transfers can be connected via API to external providers for real-time availability.

  • API connection for managing international transfers.
  • Offline management of activities and excursions.

Tours & excursions management

Bookings > Tours

Offline creation and management of tours and organized excursions, with itineraries, services and capacities.

Package tours

Bookings > Packages

Offline management of travel packages such as package tours, Umrah and other combined offers.

Visa sales management

Bookings > Visa

Offline management of visa services based on per-destination pricing.

03Customer relations

CRM & Customer Experience

Access: Main Menu › CRM

Travelife's CRM (Customer Relationship Management) module is the nerve center of your relationship intelligence. Designed specifically for travel agencies, it centralizes all interactions with your partners (B2B) and travelers (B2C). This unified database enables advanced segmentation, sales performance tracking and complete traceability of every exchange.

Third-party management & data integrity

360° customer & traveler profile

CRM > Customers > Customer list

Keep the complete history of your travelers for highly personalized service. Travelife compiles every transaction, preference and legal document in a single interface.

  • Classification: segment your accounts by type (Corporate, Individual).
  • Traveler details: management of passports, loyalty programs and dietary preferences.
  • Financial balance: real-time view of sales history, payments received and outstanding receivables.

Supplier & partner profile

CRM > Suppliers > Supplier list

As with customer management, Travelife provides a comprehensive supplier profile to manage your relationships with service providers (hotels, carriers, guides).

  • Operational history: complete tracking of all bookings made, cancelled or modified with this provider.
  • Accounting tracking: instant access to purchase invoices, payments issued and the supplier balance.

Traceability & sales workflow

Communication history

CRM > Communication Log

Ensure full transparency across your teams with an audit log of all exchanges. Every outgoing interaction is recorded for legal and commercial traceability.

  • Email archiving: tracking of proposals, quotes and confirmations sent directly from the ERP.
  • Sender identification: precise history showing which agent sent each message and when.
  • Attachment tracking: access to the specific versions of proposals or invoices sent to the customer.

Pipelines & conversion

CRM > Sales pipelines

Manage your conversion funnel from identifying the need to final confirmation. Spot high-value opportunities and analyze the velocity of your sales cycles.

  • Lead status: visual tracking of stages (Qualification, Proposal, Negotiation).

Support & data quality

Ticket management & after-sales service

CRM > Tasks & Tickets

Structure your customer support and complaint handling. The ticketing system lets you prioritize special requests and ensure optimal response times.

Database hygiene

CRM > Customers > Duplicate management

The system uses smart algorithms to detect duplicate entries. Secure merging preserves financial and operational history with no data loss.

04Sales

Sales & sales administration

Access: Main Menu › Sales

The Sales module is the conversion engine of Travelife ERP. It lets you manage the entire transaction cycle, from designing a custom offer to managing financial commitments with suppliers. This section centralizes API and manual booking flows for complete control over your product catalog.

Offer design & proposals

Creating quotes & tour proposals

Sales > Proposals > New quote

Design tailor-made offers by combining different services. This guide explains how the system allows precise manual entry to adapt each price line to the customer's needs.

  • New quote: manual creation interface for fast, personalized offers.
  • Quote list: tracking console to follow up on proposals awaiting approval.
  • Tour proposal list: dedicated management of complex itineraries and organized tours.

Quotation & cost calculation

Sales > Quotation

A financial planning tool for group travel or complex projects. Calculate your margins before the quote is even issued.

  • New quotation: cost and gross margin simulator per booking file.
  • Quotation list: history of pricing studies carried out for your customers.

Sales & order management

Customer order cycle

Sales > Sales

Turn your opportunities into actual revenue. This sub-module handles the transition from the sales offer to the confirmed booking file.

  • New order: recording of confirmed sales with automatic generation of booking file references.
  • Order list: overview of the progress of all agency sales.
  • Sales report: analytical reporting on sales performance by period, agent or product.

Supplier orders & POs

Sales > Purchases

Manage your commitments with your partners. The system generates the purchase orders (POs) needed to secure services.

  • Order list: centralization of purchase commitments with service providers.
  • Purchase report: cost price analysis for strict profitability control.

Book Offline & manual inventory

Offline bookings

Sales > Book Offline

Follow this guide for services not connected via API (local guides, restaurants, small hotels): this module lets you manually add each service to the overall booking file.

  • New booking: manual entry of ground services (flight, accommodation, transfer, activity, boat, extra).
  • Booking list: summary of all manually entered services for operational follow-up.

Inventory & service list

Sales > Bookings

View all booked services, whether they come from an automated feed or manual entry.

  • Ticket / flight list: complete tracking of air ticket issuance.
  • Hotel list (internal & API): monitoring of confirmed room nights.
  • Package list: consolidated view of combined products sold.
05Finance

Financial management & Accounting / Cash

Access: Main Menu › Accounting / Cash

The Accounting / Cash module of Travelife ERP is an end-to-end financial management solution designed to meet the accounting requirements of travel agencies. It bridges sales operations and cost accounting, giving you complete control over customer collections, supplier disbursements and tax compliance (VAT, credit reports).

Invoicing management (customers & suppliers)

Invoicing & collection cycle

Accounting / Cash > Customers

Optimize your revenue streams with automated invoice and payment management. The system gives you a clear view of outstanding receivables per customer.

  • Invoicing: single invoices, batch invoicing (grouping) and credit note management.
  • Payments: entry of single or multiple payments (one payment for several invoices).
  • Analytics: detailed financial statement and billing report to track uninvoiced booking files.

Purchases & payables management

Accounting / Cash > Suppliers

Control your cost prices by matching received invoices with your actual bookings. Avoid overpaying service providers.

  • Entry: recording of supplier invoices and management of purchase credit notes.
  • Payments: tracking of payments issued and bank transaction history.
  • Oversight: supplier financial statement to anticipate payment due dates and cash requirements.

Treasury & cash flow

Liquidity monitoring

Accounting / Cash > Cash registers

Track the money available in your various points of sale or bank accounts in real time. The system ensures every cent is fully traceable.

  • Cash report: instant view of the theoretical and actual balance of your physical cash registers.
  • Transactions: comprehensive log of all incoming (sales) and outgoing (expenses/purchases) flows.
  • Reconciliation: bank matching tool to check that your statements agree with the ERP.

Analytics & balances

Accounting / Cash > Accounting

A high-level view of the company's financial health. See instantly who owes you money and what you owe your partners.

  • Third-party balances: overall lists of debit balances (customers) and credit balances (suppliers).
  • Payment methods: analysis of taxes and fees applied by collection method (card terminal, bank transfer, etc.).

Taxation & DGI compliance

VAT control

Accounting / Cash > Accounting > VAT

Automate your tax returns with reports that comply with current regulations. The system separates taxable flows from exempt flows.

  • VAT Control: check of VAT collected on sales against payments received.
  • Supplier VAT Control: tracking of recoverable VAT on purchase invoices.

Credit & risk management

Accounting / Cash > Accounting > Credit reports

Anticipate financial risks with credit reports. These reports let you monitor when account customers exceed their authorized credit limits.

  • Customer credit report: analysis of customer risk and average payment times.
  • Supplier credit report: tracking of credit obtained from your strategic partners.
06Operations

Booking file & project management

Access: Main Menu › Booking files

The Booking Files module is the central management tool for your group travel (GIT), tours and MICE events. It provides precise oversight of profitability by consolidating individual sales and group purchase commitments in a single dashboard.

Operational management & yield

Load factor tracking (pax)

Progress indicators

See the sales performance of your departures at a glance with dynamic progress indicators.

  • Capacity vs occupancy: real-time display of seats sold out of total inventory (e.g. 3 / 17 seats).
  • Load factor: automatic calculation of the occupancy percentage to adjust your marketing actions.
  • Logistics status: tracking of booking files that are “In progress”, “Confirmed” or “Closed”.

Financial performance

Actual and forecast margins

Analyze the financial health of each project with complete accuracy on actual and forecast margins.

  • Sales (revenue): total of customer orders linked to the project.
  • Gross margin & markup rate: real-time calculation of net profit and the markup applied to the booking file.
  • Uninvoiced purchases: alert for supplier commitments whose invoice has not yet been recorded.

Consolidated flows (sales & purchases)

Booking file sales journal

Customer tracking

Centralize all customer orders (invoiced or not) linked to a specific project for flawless customer follow-up.

  • Traceability: complete list of linked order numbers (CO) and invoices (FA).
  • Details by customer: quick identification of travelers, unit amounts and invoicing status.

Purchase journal & group purchases

Cost price control

Control your cost prices by recording the overall supplier services required to run the group smoothly.

  • Add a group purchase: easy entry of supplier invoices (accommodation, transport, guide) affecting the entire booking file.
  • PO control: tracking of purchase orders to ensure booked services match the invoices received.
07Operations

Logistics planning & coordination

Access: Main Menu › Planning

Travelife's Planning module is your agency's scheduling control center. It provides a panoramic, interactive view of all booked services, enabling operations teams to coordinate traveler flows with pinpoint precision.

Calendar views & monitoring

Dynamic accommodation calendar

Planning > Hotels

Track the status of hotel bookings day by day. The planner visually distinguishes the booking source for faster operational response.

  • Contract hotel: view of room nights booked on your own directly negotiated contracts.
  • API hotel: tracking of bookings confirmed via partner platforms' XML feeds.
  • Book Offline: monitoring of manually entered bookings for offline providers.
  • Capacity: direct display of the number of rooms and bookings per property.

Movement coordination

Planning > Activities & Flights

Stay on top of transport flows and activities to avoid any break in the traveler's service chain.

  • Activities: overview of the schedule of excursions, transfers and ground services to optimize dispatching of guides and drivers.
  • Flights: monitoring of air arrivals and departures, essential for coordinating airport meet-and-greets and shuttles.

Operational benefits

Logistics planning ahead

Weekly view

With the weekly view, agents can anticipate peak periods and check room availability at a glance.

Centralized sources

A single calendar

Travelife brings data from different sources (API, manual entry, inventory contracts) together in a single calendar, ensuring no service is overlooked.

FAQ

Travelife ERP user guide FAQ

Where to find a feature, how to track your margins or contact support: quick answers from the Travelife manual.

A technical question?

Travelife customers are supported by the assistance team, with remote assistance when needed.

support@travelife.maBook a demo
How do I create a quote in Travelife ERP?

To create a quote in Travelife, open the Sales > Proposals > New quote menu. This manual creation interface lets you design a tailor-made offer by combining different services and adapting each price line to the customer's needs.

Issued quotes are then tracked in the Quote list, so you can follow up on proposals awaiting approval. For group travel or a complex project, first use Sales > Quotation to simulate costs and gross margin before issuing the quote. Once accepted, the quote becomes an order in Sales > Sales.

How do I track the margin on a group trip in Travelife?

Group trip margins are tracked in the Booking Files module (Main Menu > Booking files), designed for group travel (GIT), tours and MICE events.

Each booking file shows, in real time, the revenue from linked customer orders, gross margin and markup rate, as well as the load factor (for example 3 / 17 seats). Group purchases (accommodation, transport, guide) are entered in the booking file's purchase journal, and an alert flags supplier commitments whose invoice has not yet been recorded. You therefore know the actual profitability of each departure.

How do I control VAT with Travelife software?

VAT control is handled in Accounting / Cash > Accounting > VAT. Travelife produces reports that comply with current regulations (DGI compliance) and separates taxable flows from exempt flows.

The VAT Control report checks VAT collected on sales against payments received, and Supplier VAT Control tracks recoverable VAT on purchase invoices. These reports make it easier to prepare your tax returns. Customer and supplier credit reports, in the same Accounting menu, round out the agency's financial management.

Can Travelife handle services that are not connected via API?

Yes. The Sales > Book Offline module lets you manually add services not connected via API, such as local guides, restaurants or small hotels.

You can enter flights, accommodation, transfers, activities, boats or extras directly in the customer's overall booking file. These offline bookings then appear in the booking list and in Planning, alongside API bookings and direct hotel contracts. Travelife thus centralizes all sources in a single calendar so that no service is overlooked.

Is Travelife ERP training provided at onboarding?

Yes. As soon as your license is activated, Travelife experts run a full training session for your teams, so they master the operational workflow from A to Z, from creating a customer to closing the books.

After training, this user guide serves as a module-by-module reference. For any technical question, the support team responds by email at support@travelife.ma, with remote assistance when needed, and a dedicated WhatsApp group lets you talk directly with the technical team according to your maintenance plan.
